pronounced metrical difference between a draft and a fair copy by S., it is impossible to say,
on the basis of the available evidence, whether the metrical variants were introduced by S.
into a now-lost intermediate draft or fair copy, or whether they were introduced by Mary
into her fair copy with S.’s approval, or even whether Mary introduced them on her own
authority, although that would seem unlikely. On balance, given the commissioned nature
of the lines and Mary’s indication of the authorship ‘By Shelley’, the present text follows
